title: THE MOST DANGEROUS PRAYER THE ENEMY DOESN'T WANT YOU TO PRAY— BLOOD OF JESUS ARISE
text: Stop everything right now. Before one song, before one announcement, before anything else in this service tonight, I need everybody in this building to stretch their right hand forward and close your eyes. Don't look around. Don't worry about who is sitting next to you. Don't manage your appearance. Just close your eyes and stretch your hand forward. The reason I am doing this before anything else tonight is because the spirit of the living God met me this morning. Not in my study, not in my prayer room. He met me while I was walking and he stopped me and he said, "Tell them the blood is speaking. Tell them the blood has never stopped speaking. Tell them the reason the enemy has fought so hard against the revelation of the blood is because he knows he knows that when a believer fully understands what the blood of Jesus means, that believer becomes a weapon he cannot successfully resist." I said, "Lord, are you sure that is the word for tonight?" And he said, "That is not just the word for tonight. That is the word for the season. That is the breakthrough revelation that has been held up because the enemy understood that if it broke through, certain captivities would end immediately." So, before you even hear the teaching, before we even open the scriptures formally, open your mouth right now and say, "Blood of Jesus, speak for me tonight. Blood of Jesus, arise on my behalf. Blood of Jesus, be my testimony." Say it again with everything in you. "Blood of Jesus, arise." Now, be seated in the fire of the Holy Ghost. Turn in your Bibles to Hebrews chapter 12 and verse 24. Hebrews chapter 12 verse 24 and we will anchor a second scripture in Revelation chapter 12 verse 11. Hebrews 12 verse 24 says, "And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel." The blood of sprinkling that speaketh, present tense, not spoke, not used to speak, speaketh. The blood of Jesus Christ is a speaking blood. It has a voice, it has language. It has the capacity to communicate in realms that your natural voice cannot reach. And Revelation 12:11 declares, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony, and they loved not their lives onto the death." They overcame him, not they managed him, not they coped with him, not they negotiated with him, they overcame him. Total victory, total conquest, complete and comprehensive defeat of the enemy. And the primary instrument of that overcoming was the blood of the lamb. Now, I want you to hear me very carefully as I begin to teach, because what I am about to say is going to reframe how you approach spiritual warfare for the rest of your life. The blood of Jesus is not a religious phrase, it is not a metaphor, it is not a Christian tradition. The blood of Jesus is the most legally powerful substance in the entire universe in both the natural and the supernatural. And the enemy's primary strategy against believers has not been to make them immoral or to make them doubt God's existence. His primary strategy has been to make them ignorant of or passive about the blood. Because here is what the enemy understands that many believers have never been taught. The blood of Jesus is the basis of every covenant right you have before God. Every promise you stand on, every prayer you pray, every spiritual authority you exercise, every healing you claim, every deliverance you enforce, every blessing you receive, all of it, every single spiritual benefit is accessible to you only because of the blood. Ephesians 1:7, "In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace. Redemption through his blood, not through his teaching. Not through his example, not through his miracles, through his blood. Colossians 1:20, and having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself. Peace through the blood of his cross. The enmity between God and man resolved by blood. The wall of separation torn down by blood. The access to the throne of grace opened by blood. And this is why the enemy hates the blood, because the blood is evidence that the price has been paid. The blood is the receipt of the transaction. When you plead the blood of Jesus, you are not performing a ritual. You are presenting evidence in the courts of heaven that the debt has been settled, [music] the penalty has been paid, the victory has been secured. Let me show you something in the Old Testament that is going to make this so clear, you will never approach the blood the same way again. Turn to Exodus chapter 12, verses 12 and 13, the Passover. God told the children of Israel, "Take the blood of the lamb and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of your houses." And he said, "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you." I want you to see four things in that verse. The blood was a token, not a feeling, not a prayer, not a wish, a token, a visible, applied, active sign. God said, "When I see the blood." God's response was not triggered by their emotions, not triggered by how much they fasted, not triggered by how long they prayed, it was triggered by the presence of the blood. When God saw the blood, he acted. He said, "The plague shall not be upon you, not near you, not around you." Upon you, direct contact was blocked by the blood. And then he said, "I will pass over you." This is the origin of the word Passover. The destroyer came, but he had to pass over every house where the blood was applied. He could not touch what the blood covered. Now, hear me. Jesus is the lamb of God. John 1:29. He is the Passover lamb. 1 Corinthians 5:7. And his blood, applied by faith over your life, your home, your family, your marriage, your finances, your children, makes you untouchable to the destroyer. The enemy is not passing over your home because you are good enough. He's not passing over your children because they are smart enough. He's not passing over your marriage because you have worked hard enough at it. He passes over what the blood covers. He cannot touch what the blood has been applied to. And this is the prayer he does not want you to pray. He does not want you to understand the blood. He does not want you to deliberately, intelligently, aggressively apply the blood by faith over every area of your life. Because when you do, you activate the most ancient covenant protection in the history of redemption. Let me go deeper. Leviticus 17:11. For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls. For it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul. The life is in the blood. The Hebrew word for life here is nephesh. It speaks of soul, of being, of the full essence of a living thing. When Jesus shed his blood, he poured out his life, his divine life, his eternal, uncreated, sinless life entered the blood and was offered upon the altar of the cross. This means when you plead the blood of Jesus, you are not invoking a dead religious formula. You are invoking divine life. You are releasing the potency of the eternal life of the Son of God against every work of darkness in your situation. No wonder the enemy does not want you to pray this prayer. No wonder he has kept so many believers busy praying long, complicated prayers while neglecting the most powerful legal weapon in their arsenal. Peter said in 1 Peter 1:18 and 19, "For as much as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers, but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot." Precious blood. The word precious in the Greek is timios. It speaks of something of extraordinary worth, of incomparable value, of a cost that cannot be calculated by any human measure. Silver and gold are corruptible. They rust, they devalue, they lose purchasing power, but the blood of Jesus is incorruptible. It does not lose potency with time, it does not expire. It does not become less effective because of how many generations have passed. The blood shed at Calvary 2,000 years ago is just as fresh, just as powerful, just as legally effective today as it was the moment it fell from the body of Jesus onto the ground of Golgotha. Somebody shout the blood still works. Now, let me show you something that is going to ignite your warfare. In Revelation chapter 5, when John saw the heavenly scene and the sealed book that no one could open, he wept greatly. But then in verse 9, when the lamb that was slain took the book, the living creatures and the elders sang a new song, "Thou art worthy to take the book and to open the seals thereof. For thou was slain and has redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred and tongue and people and nation. The lamb's worthiness to execute God's agenda on earth, his authority to break seals, to open what is shut, to release what is held, to bring to pass the decrees of God was grounded in the blood. The blood is what gave him the right to open the sealed book. What does this mean for us? It means that when you pray in the name of Jesus and plead the blood, you are invoking the authority of the one who has the legal right to open every sealed thing over your life. Every dream that has been sealed, every prophecy that has been sealed, every blessing that has been sealed, every door that has been shut, every vault of destiny that has been locked. The lamb who was slain by his blood has the authority to open it all. And when you come to God under the covering of that blood, you are not coming as a desperate beggar hoping for mercy. You are coming as a blood bought, righteousness clothed, covenant secured, legally backed child of the most high God, and heaven must respond. Now we are going to pray, and this prayer is going to be unlike any prayer you have prayed before because you are not going to pray from a place of begging. You are going to pray from a place of presenting the blood as legal evidence. You are going to present the blood as your covenant right. You are going to arise behind the blood of Jesus and take back everything the enemy has stolen. Before we begin, I need you to make a declaration. Say this out loud wherever you are. I am blood bought. I am blood covered. I am blood defended. The blood of Jesus Christ, the son of the living God, speaks on my behalf in every court, natural and supernatural. And as I pray tonight, I stand not in my own name, not in my own righteousness, not in my own strength, but in the name and by the blood of the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. Heaven, hear my blood back prayer tonight. Now, let us begin. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, we approach you through the new and living way that was consecrated for us through the veil of his flesh. Hebrews 10: 19 and 20. We do not come to you through religious performance, we do not come through the works of the law, we do not come through our goodness or our righteousness, we come through the blood, through the blood, through the blood. And Lord, we present that blood tonight as our access, as our advocate, as our argument before your throne. The blood of Jesus is speaking, and what it speaks is better than what any accuser says about us. The blood speaks righteousness. [music] The blood speaks acceptance. The blood speaks victory. The blood speaks redemption. The blood speaks healing. The blood speaks deliverance. And the blood speaks freedom. Blood of Jesus, arise in this gathering tonight. Arise over every life. Arise over every situation. Arise over every case that has been lying dormant. Arise over every prayer that has been delayed. Arise over every promise that has not yet been fulfilled. Blood of Jesus, arise. Now, in the name of Jesus, I come against every satanic accusation that has been presented before the throne of God against the people in this gathering. He says, "This person sinned. This person failed. This person is not worthy. This person's prayer should not be answered. But the [clears throat] blood of Jesus is a more powerful advocate than any accusation the enemy can raise. 1 John 2:1. I decree every legal ground that the enemy had to operate in the lives of the people in this gathering is being destroyed right now. Every spirit of sudden death, of accident, of violence, of mysterious sickness designed to kill be destroyed now. In the name of Jesus. In the name of Jesus. I speak now to witchcraft. I know there are people in this gathering who have been under sustained witchcraft attack. Not just spiritual warfare in a general sense, specific, targeted, coordinated, sustained witchcraft. Someone sat at an altar with your name. Someone performed a ritual with something connected to you. Someone spoke death and destruction over your life with deliberate, calculated evil intent. And you have felt it. You wake up tired. Your dreams are full of darkness and terror. Things keep going wrong at the exact moment they should succeed. That is not bad luck. That is not coincidence. That is an assignment, and it is legal for the enemy to execute that assignment only as long as there is no blood covering on your life. But tonight, the blood of Jesus is being applied. And I'm going to tell you what happens when the blood of Jesus confronts a witchcraft assignment.
